summary: Share equivalent numeric TTL cache keys across provider clients

delivery.outcome: Make equivalent numeric TTLs share the same canonical provider HTTP cache identity, independently publish the fix and qualify its already authorized proxy11435 runtime promotion.
nonGoals: No new cache backends, dependencies, authorization behavior, provider transport, inference caching or consumer repository changes.

architecture.decision: Normalize validated HTTP cache TTL to float once at construction, retaining the existing identity for distinct actual lifetimes and all current account/origin/header/request guards. No persisted records are moved or rewritten; older integer-TTL entries expire by the existing TTL policy.
architecture.rollback: Protected source revert and restore previous immutable proxy runtime; retain the private credentials file and previous release unchanged.

validation.evidence: Integer/floating TTL aliases reuse a cached result, including independent process restarts.
Distinct TTLs remain separate; all account/origin, invalidation and freshness regressions pass.
Exact-head independent merge, real upstream catalog qualification and production cross-process integer-TTL cache hit.
